name: ZoneLogistic fulfillment
author: zonelogistic

sections.description:
Streamline your e-commerce fulfillment with our Hungary-based logistics solution. Our app connects your Shopify store to our advanced warehouse system in just a few clicks.
Whether you’re selling locally or across Europe, we offer reliable fulfillment, multiple courier support, with real-time updates.

External services

This plugin connects to the ZoneLogistic API to exchange products, logistics and order information between your WooCommerce store and the ZoneLogistic system.

The external service is operated by Fuseler Kft. and is used for:
– Synchronizing product data.
– Sending and managing order information.
– Retrieving available delivery methods.
– Registering your WordPress site with your ZoneLogistic account.

Data sent:
When the plugin communicates with the ZoneLogistic API, it may send:
– Product information (name, SKU, stock, price, weight, dimensions, main image).
– Order data (order ID, customer name, shipping address, phone number, email, ordered items, order total, delivery method, payment method, other fees).
– Your website domain and site name (during initial registration).
– The authentication token configured in your WordPress settings.

These requests are made securely over HTTPS and are only triggered when you perform related actions in the plugin (e.g., creating an order or syncing products).

Service provider:
Fuseler Kft.
API base URL: https://portal.zonelogistic.hu/api/v1/
Privacy Policy: https://www.zonelogistic.hu/adatvedelem
